content.title: The Pitt Season 2 Episode 10 Photos “4:00 PM”
content.text: The Pitt continues its intense real-time medical drama with The Pitt Season 2 Episode 10, “4:00 PM.” The episode marks another critical hour in the emergency department’s grueling shift as the doctors and nurses struggle to keep up with the growing number of patients. In The Pitt Season 2 Episode 10, the hospital finds itself short-staffed, forcing Dr. Robby and the rest of the team to step up and manage the escalating workload. As the shift continues to spiral, the staff must rely on teamwork and quick decision-making to keep patients alive while navigating the pressure of the overcrowded emergency room. The series follows the doctors, nurses, and medical staff of Pittsburgh Trauma Medical Center — known as “The Pitt” — as they tackle one intense hour of their shift in each episode, highlighting the challenges and emotional toll of frontline medicine. “4:00 PM” continues the season’s escalating tension as the long day inside the emergency department pushes the team closer to their limits. Episode Details The Pitt Season 2 Episode 10 – “4:00 PM” Airdate: March 12, 2026 Known for its realistic portrayal of hospital life, The Pitt continues to explore the professional and personal struggles of the medical staff as they work tirelessly to save lives. Set inside a modern-day hospital in Pittsburgh, The Pitt offers a grounded and unflinching look at the challenges facing healthcare workers in today’s America. The series places viewers alongside frontline doctors and staff as they navigate overcrowded emergency rooms, limited resources, ethical dilemmas, and emotional exhaustion. Returning to anchor the series is Noah Wyle as Dr. Michael “Robby” Robinavitch. A seasoned physician and reluctant leader, Robby enters season two carrying the weight of past decisions while facing new pressures that test both his authority and compassion. The ensemble cast returns, deepening the hospital’s interconnected world. Season two stars Patrick Ball as Dr. Langdon, Katherine LaNasa as Dana Evans, Supriya Ganesh as Dr. Mohan, Fiona Dourif as Dr. McKay, Taylor Dearden as Dr. King, Isa Briones as Dr. Santos, Gerran Howell as Whitaker, Shabana Azeez as Javadi, and Sepideh Moafi as Dr. Al-Hashimi. Each character brings a distinct perspective to the pressures of modern medicine, reinforcing the show’s commitment to realism and emotional authenticity. Created by R. Scott Gemmill, The Pitt is produced by John Wells Productions in association with Warner Bros. Television. With a creative team rooted in prestige drama, the series balances procedural urgency with long-form storytelling that allows characters and themes to evolve naturally over the course of the season.
